# generated by tools/sprites/build.py -- do not edit by hand

anim move 12 loop 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7

# attack: aim 0-3, fire at 4 (0.4-0.5 s, the engine shoots at 0.45 s)
anim attack 10 once 16 17 18 19 20 21 22 23
anim hurt 12 once 24 25 26
